profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Intel Corporation
profile.summary:
Results-oriented software engineer with over 10 year of program management, project management, and integration experience managing high-complexity, broad scope automation programs across multiple organizations with diverse and competing priorities.
•	Strategic vision to identify design/process improvements that get results
•	Consistent record to achieve goals on time and within budgets
•	Proven ability to build high-performance teams that meet and beat objectives
•	Detailed-oriented, quick learner with a passion for planning and continuous improvement
Accomplishments
•	Operational data store program manager >$12 million ROI (Intel Achievement Award)
•	Technical supplier manager contributed to supplier obtaining the Intel Preferred Quality Supplier (PQS) award

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Partnered with equipment suppliers to ensure equipment software quality and equipment 
automation readiness.  Partnered with a software supplier to attain the Intel Preferred Quality Supplier award.

positions.title: Access Project Manager
positions.description: Project manager responsible to ensure circuits are delivered in a timely manner across Europe, Asia, Middle East, Africa and Latin America.

positions.title: Senior Technical Integrator
positions.description: Managed strategic exploration activities from exploration to planning phase to identify ROI, set strategic direction and intercept plan for Assembly Test Development capabilities roadmap such as organization’s vision for RFID in the manufacturing environment, automated visual inspection process for metrology, excursion containment and disposition.

positions.title: Program Manager
positions.description:
Managed programs with the focus to bring integration to wide spread automation efforts across Manufacturing, Engineering, Finance, Capital Equipment Development, Quality Assurance, Supplier Management.  Driving programs from inception to delivery following PLC processes.
•	1266 Automation Platform Integration – Drove the 1266 platform program for automation, driving a cross-organizational, cross-functional team to identify automation impacts due to material, equipment, or process changes in the new platform and implement the necessary changes across Assembly/Test factories worldwide.
•	Unit Level Tracking - Led end-to-end integration of unit level tracking.  A two year effort across multiple organizations to deliver a new architecture, data standardization, and offline analysis that met Intel’s future needs.
•	Capacity Operational Data Store - Managed an operational data store providing OLAP based solutions to Fab Sort and Assembly Test.  Led a team of 6 to 10 programmers to deliver multiple OLAP cubes to facilitate data analysis, exceeding a $12 million ROI.
•	e-Diagnostics – Directed a small team to explore and set strategic direction for remote equipment diagnostics to enable predictive analysis allowing earlier intervention thus improving tool availability.
•	Led the successful startup of an offshore Knowledge Management group.  Responsible to identify resource needs, assess resumes, develop a training plan and served as the group’s interim manager, setting strategic direction, monitoring milestones, as well as owning the ranking and rating process.

positions.title: Technical Project Manager
positions.description:
Led Fab6/Sort6 manufacturing readiness for the Year 2000 to ensure compliance across the factory encompassing software, equipment, and facilities.  
• Assembled and led a cross-functional team and ensured appropriate engagement of resources from all departments.
• Established processes and best known methods to ensure complete testing and integration with the least amount of risk.  Many of these were later adopted by the corporate year 2000 office, positioning the factory as a leader in this effort.
